_meta.purpose: Maps our ingredient tokens to a Food_Code in thai_nutrition_hf.csv (Mahidol INMU 2015 Food Composition Tables, via BaoWio/Thai_Nutrition_Dataset on Hugging Face). Verified by downloading and inspecting the real CSV, not assumed from its dataset card.
_meta.coverage: PARTIAL. Only the ~22 ingredient tokens below have been manually checked against the 1,005-row table this session. The rest of ingredient_allergen_map.json's ~64 tokens have not been checked yet -- do not assume they're absent, they're just unverified. Extend this file the same way: search thai_nutrition_hf.csv's English_Name column, pick the best match, record why.
_meta.why_no_auto_matching: A naive substring match is actively wrong here -- e.g. searching "pork" hits 55 rows including 'noodles, wheat, instant, with seasoning, pork flavour'. Every match below was picked by hand after looking at all candidates.
_meta.why_no_per_dish_calories: This table gives nutrients per ingredient (per 100g, standard food-composition-table convention), not per dish. Our dish data has no ingredient quantities, so we cannot responsibly compute a per-dish calorie total from this -- doing so would imply false precision. Treat matches as ingredient-level reference data only, until quantities exist.
_meta.license_note: Source data is Mahidol INMU's Food Composition Tables (2015). The HF re-uploader tags this CC-BY-SA-4.0, but INMU's own site states 'free for non-commercial use with attribution' -- a re-uploader can't broaden rights they don't hold. Treat this as bound by INMU's stricter non-commercial+attribution terms until confirmed otherwise. See DATA_SOURCES.md.

tofu.note: table has 12 tofu variants (dried/firm/soft/yellow); picked a common default

egg.note: picked raw hen egg as the generic default; table also has boiled/duck/quail variants

rice noodles.note: table also has a wide/big-sized strip variant (A4) some dishes use instead

thai basil.note: no exact 'Thai basil' entry in the table; sweet basil is the closest available, botanically a different variety

kaffir lime leaves.matched_name: Leech lime or Kaffir lime, leaves

fish sauce.note: table also has a 'grade 1' variant (N72); picked the plain one

shrimp paste.note: table has first/second class quality variants too

dried chili.note: closest available; 'ground' is not the same prep as whole dried chili
